name: Floating seats
function: Two ring seats, one each side of the gate, that seal against the gate faces and are energized by line pressure and springs.

tabs.overview: The seats float in their pockets so that line pressure pushes the downstream seat against the gate. Sealant injected into the seat pocket supports the metal-to-metal seal after wear.
tabs.engineering: Hardened alloy steel with hardfaced sealing faces; back seals of elastomer or thermoplastic between seat and pocket.
tabs.safety: Seat pocket sealant injection is done under pressure with the proper grease gun and fitting; follow the OEM procedure.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for materials and testing; OEM pages (S2, S5); field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
